phase_name: sapience-remember.sh Project Tagging and Its First Test Suite

objectives.description: Add optional project-key resolution to sapience-remember.sh (resolve .sapience/project.json's cid, resolve to key via GET /v1/people/projects, add project field)
Encode the degrade rule (no binding -> untagged byte-identical; binding+resolution failure -> untagged with stderr warning, never a refusal) in code and header
Add project_cid non-goal to the header as an explicit checkable statement
Create test-sapience-remember.sh, the script's first suite, modelled on test-sapience-publish.sh's harness, covering cases (a)-(e)
Add two policy-invariant cases (f) settings-fragment.json grant set and (g) sapience-project-bind.sh has zero config.json/capture.projects references
Register the new suite via sync-manifest-scripts.sh --write
Re-run suite_selection_select over sapience-remember.sh and confirm test-sapience-remember.sh now appears in its output

approaches_tried.approach: Resolve settings-fragment.json via a SCRIPT_DIR-relative path (../../settings-fragment.json)
approaches_tried.reason: works from the source tree but fails when the suite itself runs from a deployed .claude/scripts/tests/ copy, since the fragment has no standalone deployed file (it is merge-targeted into .claude/settings.local.json) -- fixed by resolving via common_test_ext_root(REPO_ROOT) instead, which works from either tree
